title: Epistemic Record (P1 - composition root)
description: The machine-parseable epistemic record embedded in every rollout checkpoint report (between <!-- epistemic-record:begin --> and <!-- epistemic-record:end --> markers). This file IS the P1 spec - verdicts never travel as bare labels - and composes the sibling schemas by $ref: evidence refs (P2), the proposed_action draft (P4), quoted_evidence quarantine entries (P5), and the validity horizon (P6). Each referenced schema is independently loadable for harnesses adopting principles incrementally. Id namespaces: o-N are record-local observation ids; evidence_refs cite platform ids.

verdict.description: Frozen vocabulary - must equal the stage_verdict passed to record_checkpoint.

observations.description: Directly retrieved facts with no causal language. Every observation cites the evidence that backs it (P2).

inferences.description: Derived claims. May be empty (abstention may infer nothing), but the key must be present. An inference citing no observation is an opinion and is schema-invalid.

alternatives.description: Competing explanations still open. An empty array is an explicit claim: alternatives were considered and none remain.

confidence.description: Qualitative only - the schema structurally forbids numeric confidence.

unknowns.description: Missing information that materially limits the conclusion. Literal ["none"] is the explicit-empty form; silence is not.

discriminating_checks.description: The next queries most likely to confirm OR overturn the verdict. At least one unless abstaining (see if/then below); when abstaining, name what would make the next checkpoint decidable.

quoted_evidence.description: Trust-boundary quarantine entries (P5). Present whenever evidence contains instruction-shaped, approval-claiming, or pressure text.
